description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the News model in the Goteo application, testing creation, validation, deletion, and retrieval of News objects.

classes.name: Goteo\Model\Tests\NewsTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for Goteo Model News, testing object creation, validation, deletion, and retrieval.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the News object and confirms it is of the correct class.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests the validation and save methods of the News object, expecting both to return false in this context.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates a News object with sample data, validates, saves, retrieves, checks properties, deletes, and re-saves to test persistence and deletion.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Tests retrieval and deletion of a non-existent News object, expecting both to return false.
